newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-QCT says coking coal outlook healthy.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-QCT says coking coal outlook healthy.

text.p: Coal miner QCT Resources Ltd said on Tuesday the demand for coking coal remained strong despite softening of the international steel market.
"The longer term price outlook for coking coal is healthy," chairman Allister McLeod told the annual meeting.

"The prospects for growth of coking coal demand are strengthening due to planned construction of new integrated steel mills in Asia and the addition of new blast furnaces at existing steel mills," McLeod said.

McLeod said the capability of many international coking coal competitors is diminishing with rising costs, the exhaustion of economic reserves and reduction in government subsidies in some producing countries.
"Thermal coal is a different story. The number of new projects being proposed cloud the long term price outlook for thermal coal, despite the assured growth in demand," McLeod said.
He said thermal coal supply from major international competitors is fully sold and demand growth in Asia remains strong.
At 1.45 p.m. (0245 GMT), QCT shares were two cents lower at A$1.71.
